title: CARE / FIELD
role: specialized projection of CONTINUITY for real-world human/animal care observation, longitudinal follow-up and clinician/vet handoff
invariants: no generated diagnosis or urgency score
provider/vet plan is stored with source when known
spatial marks are evidence, not anatomical diagnosis
private case state remains browser-local unless user explicitly exports/shares

conversions.human_port: Two explicit paths: CONTACT BRIEF uses human.port.handoff.v01 and NEED when ASK exists; PORT CASE emits an exact hashed JSON snapshot into human.port.object.session.v01 for focus/routing/admission.
conversions.bodyfield_geometry_rule: Preserve BODYFIELD fragment metadata and trace point arrays in their source coordinate frame; do not render them on CARE's compact silhouette without an explicit registration transform.

step_back_checks: explicit unknown count and latest-event freshness
body-plan coordinate frame preserved when spatial observations are present
session-only evidence reference that may outlive source availability
non_goals: automatic causal interpretation of metric change

course.purpose: represent clinician/vet-supplied or deliberately chosen care trajectory without turning the tool into a diagnosis engine
law: CONDITIONAL GATE must retain source when known
metric trend is descriptive only; no threshold is invented
owner/when belongs to handoff continuity, not clinical interpretation
stable location identity = plan_id + view + region_id
reference body plan is not registered personal anatomy
no remote anatomy asset fetch at runtime
trace coordinates remain in the active plan/view SVG coordinate frame
event body_map stores geometry_version + view_box + trace coordinate space for replay

body_handoff.admission: offer only; user must click IMPORT INTO CURRENT CASE
body_handoff.law: BODY EVENT != CARE CASE until explicit import

care_to_port.identity: snapshot object_id = case id + exact snapshot SHA-256 prefix; semantic case id remains provenance.source_ref
care_to_port.law: CASE != PORT SNAPSHOT; snapshot preserves exact case revision and may be focused/routed without mutating CARE.

port_to_care.admission: offer only; user must click ATTACH TO CURRENT CASE
port_to_care.storage: CARE stores object identity/hash/provenance/focus + bounded excerpt; local file/image bytes remain in HUMAN PORT IndexedDB
port_to_care.law: PORT OBJECT != CARE EVIDENCE until explicit attach; ATTACH != INTERPRET.
